en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 9. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Ḥasan ibn ‘Ali Al-Kūfi, from ‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir, from Abān, from Abil Nāb Ḥusain ibn ‘Aťiyyah Bayyā’ Al-Sāburi, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say: Allāh will register the reward of a Hajj and an ‘Umrah – or he (a.s.) said an ‘Umrah and a Hajj – for those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).
